cards.headline: The song first surfaced as a 2019 demo single
cards.snippet: Hong Kong indie duo my little airport put out 詩歌舞街 as a demo single in 2019. The band's discography places it among that year's singles, next to 下了兩天雨, 今夜雪糕, 吳小姐 and K同學. Several of those 2019 releases, posted on YouTube from July of that year, took the protest movement then underway in Hong Kong as their subject.
cards.context: The demo is the version on the main upload; a fan notes it feels better than the later release.

cards.headline: Band started in a boutique, with songs named after classmates
cards.snippet: In 2003, Lam Pang (Ah P) and Selene Au met as journalism students at Baptist-area Shue Yan college in Hong Kong. Bored by class, they kept going after lessons to a boutique run by a classmate, Josephine. A guitar was kept in the shop, and Ah P used it to write songs named after female classmates. He tried to recruit classmates into a band. It began with five members but ended up as just Ah P and Selene, who became my little airport.
cards.context: Origin of the Hong Kong duo, who met in 2003.

cards.headline: The street's name is the whole heartbreak
cards.snippet: 詩歌舞街的英文是Sycamore Street, 直譯就是無花果街.................恰好是一段無花無果的戀情
cards.context: Sycamore means fig tree, and 無花果 (fig) literally reads 'no flower, no fruit', which fits a love story that went nowhere.

replies.author: @Thenakuzjack
replies.text: 無花果其實係有花的,只不過好細,花生係果入面, 所以佢地係隱頭花序

cards.headline: A plain street made beautiful
cards.snippet: 你總能將很細微的事物寫得很可愛，好可能係旁人無法欣賞的美，例如詩歌舞街 地上有著光點閃閃，可能只是一條普通的街道，但你將條街寫得好美
cards.context: Captures why fans love the band: finding beauty in tiny, ordinary Hong Kong details.

replies.author: @idno9ses
replies.text: 但其實真正嘅詩歌舞街地上係好多狗屎 係放狗黑點嚟 利申係個邊返學

cards.headline: He walked to the street to check the sparkles
cards.snippet: 我說：是的，那兒真的光點閃閃。這一生好像很多事也沒有得解釋，我認為是，它就是了。
cards.context: The commenter visited the real street, found only gravel, and then told a friend it sparkles anyway.

cards.headline: The sparkles are real, and there's a reason
cards.snippet: 親自去左詩歌舞街睇，地下真係有好靚既光點閃閃，可能係因為用左溝左玻璃碎既環保磚來鋪地。
cards.context: A visitor says the street really glitters, possibly because the eco paving bricks contain crushed glass. It contradicts the gravel in another comment.

replies.text: 我系美國LA CITY ROAD ENGINEER 係Hollywood用GLASSphalt会反光同Sycamore詩歌舞街1祥.

cards.headline: Live 17 Nov 2024, final night, with a full-crowd singalong
cards.snippet: Recorded on 17 November 2024, the last show (尾場) of the band's run, with the audience singing the Cantonese lyrics along in a mass singalong (現場大合唱). It's a fan-shot live take, 3 minutes long.
cards.context: Fan-channel upload, but from a major live run. 11k views.
